reason: A command-line integration that uses the Grok TUI as a frontend for DeepSeek Harness, with explicit local setup, backend lifecycle commands, and usage metric displays.

summaries.zh: 将 Grok TUI 接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供本地配置桥接、后端进程管理和用量指标展示。
summaries.en: Connects the Grok TUI to DeepSeek Harness with local bridge setup, backend process controls, and usage metrics.

capabilities: Bridges the Grok TUI frontend to a DeepSeek Harness web host
Installs a profile bridge and plugin link in the local dsh configuration
Starts, stops, restarts, and reports status for standalone backend processes
Displays token and performance usage metrics
